x10_richness_gate.effective_rank_definition: exp(-sum_j p_j*log(p_j)), where p_j are normalized squared singular values of the weighted standardized sparse design matrix after deterministic one-hot encoding and removal of zero-variance columns
x10_richness_gate.interpretation: The promised x10 refers to source-backed state dimensions; a separate >=3x effective-rank gate prevents highly redundant columns from masquerading as information enrichment.
x10_richness_gate.missingness_rule: A field with >80% structural/nonresponse missingness cannot count toward the 60-field gate unless missing/not-applicable is itself substantively defined and source-coded.
